description: This file defines the StandaloneMainActivity class, which demonstrates the creation and management of different types of notifications on Android Wear devices, including styles like BigText, BigPicture, Inbox, and Messaging. It also handles user interactions such as notification actions and inline replies, and manages permission checks for notifications.

classes.name: StandaloneMainActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating notification creation with various styles and handling user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up RecyclerView and notification manager, and defines item selection behavior.

methods.name: itemSelected
methods.description: Handles user selection of notification styles and triggers corresponding notification generation methods.

methods.name: generateBigTextStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a BigText style notification with actions and compatibility considerations for Wear OS.

methods.name: generateBigPictureStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a BigPicture style notification with inline reply support and participant details.

methods.name: generateInboxStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays an Inbox style email notification with multiple message lines.

methods.name: generateMessagingStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a Messaging style notification supporting conversation threading and inline input.

methods.name: openNotificationSettingsForApp
methods.description: Opens the app's notification settings screen for the user to enable notifications.
